> Today, we're launching EmbeddingGemma 2, expanding beyond text to unify code, images, video, and audio in a shared embedding space.
> Built on the Gemma 4 architecture and released under a commercially permissive Apache 2.0 license, EmbeddingGemma 2 has 740 million parameters.
